{{Quote|It's easy to get lost out in space around here. The other day I was too busy gazing at the nebulas to watch where I was going. Next thing I knew, I was lost. Good thing I had that 'hyperspace back to station' program installed on my navicomputer.|A [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] pilot|<ref name="SWG:aCp">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|a Car'das pilot|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Bright Jewel system''', also referred to as the '''Ord Mantell system''', contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Bright Jewel/Legends|Bright Jewel]].

==History==
{{Quote|The life of a pilot is pretty good around here. With all the pirates and Hutts flying around, the station pays well for our services.|A Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:aCp" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Space station/Legends|Space stations]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] included the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]<ref name="SWG:SK" /> and its twin station [[Nova Orion Station]],<ref name="SWG:C8" /> the dangerous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] base [[Station Gamma]], and the [[H-5 70 Mining Facility]], which was used by the [[Dynath Miners]].<ref name="SWG:SK" />

[[File:Falcon_Vader_OrdMantell.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] pursued the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the Bright Jewel system.]]

The area known as [[Darkveil Eclipse]] served as a central hub of all [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] activities in the system during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG:SK" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> several quadrants of the system were the site of a [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|battle]] between [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] and Black Sun forces.<ref name="SWG:SK" />
